short: Not ahead on any component: consumer headsets and imagined-speech user identification predate it; no online accuracy, latency or split, so the real-time practical claim is unsupported.
position: The paper changes M05, M03, M13 and M06 but is ahead on none. Consumer headsets for imagined speech, user identification from imagined-speech EEG and the group's identification-plus-intention framework predate it. M03 and M13 are not reported: no identification accuracy, calibration result, latency or online accuracy. Table I (62.00% wired, 46.67% wireless, three participants) has no stated split, and the wired-wireless drop confounds device, channel count, EOG input and recordings. The claim of bridging laboratory and real-world use does not hold.
